Hi all — quick technical check from the ingestion side. I reviewed the attached AP form and can confirm we can map the standard fields. A few details to lock down:

Required fields for portal push (minimum): invoice_number, invoice_date (ISO), invoice_total, currency, remit_to_legal_entity_id, remit_address_id, line_items (description, qty, unit_price), VAT_amount, VAT_rate (if applicable), billing_contact_email, PO_number (optional but recommended).

Format options:
- Preferred: JSON invoice payload + monthly statement CSV that lists invoice_number, net, tax, gross, and payment_status.
- Alternative: Zipped PDFs + a statement PDF (less machine friendly).

Edge cases:
- If Novus wants a single consolidated statement across entities, we need a mapping file that lists which invoices belong to which parent entity. We can generate consolidated statements but will require the mapping during onboarding.

Action: I'm attaching our onboarding instructions and a sample payload. I can produce a sample export for the AP form you provided — Kim, if you confirm the portal contact I’ll queue the sample.
